svg.title: Takeaway
svg.desc: Close on the central idea: functional decomposition alone is insufficient. A module boundary needs an owner, behavioral semantics and evidence for its guarantees. This work turns that idea into an inspectable contract package and one bounded running slice. The storage integration is real, the local chain integration is real, peers and test policy are fixtures, and the cognitive stack is specified only. The architecture can evolve without embedding cognition in DA or requiring every operation to run on chain. Pause here for discussion; the remaining slides provide method mappings, exact provenance, failure semantics and reproduction commands.
svg.text: The working slice makes that promise reviewable.
Providers are selected by declared semantics.
Receipts say precisely what was observed.
M0 + M1 delivered • No M2 implementation • Evidence and reproduction in the repository
